title: Plan
description: A Planner's output: an inspectable, versioned DAG of steps executed by the durable workflow (Requirement 5). Each step carries its own guardrail/critic/budget policy so the platform enforces the execution contract uniformly.

altitude.description: macro = learner lifecycle; micro = a single complex task.

revision_of.description: Prior plan_id if this is a re-plan.

agent.description: Agent to invoke for this step.

depends_on.description: step_ids that must complete first (DAG edges).

output_contract.description: Schema id the output must satisfy (enforced by output guardrail).

replan_triggers.description: Conditions that send the workflow back to the Planner (e.g. critic_reject, integrity_flag, budget_breach, repeated_gate_failure).
